descriptions.idol-tiki-bar: Chinese-Asian menu at a tiki bar: Hong Kong-style crispy wontons, pork bao, shoyu, miso and tonkotsu ramen, kung pao chicken, tom yum, fried noodles and rice; the bar specializes in tiki cocktails.
descriptions.x-wangs-kitchen: Chinese restaurant with a large menu of soups, noodles and dumplings; hot pot is a separate specialty. Popular dishes also include fried noodles, rice and sweet-and-sour chicken.
descriptions.kazi-vazi: Georgian khinkali bar: Megrelian khachapuri, khinkali with meat or cheese and herbs, beet and spinach pkhali, satsebeli and tsakhton sauces.
descriptions.meze-by-elliniko: Greek food designed for sharing: zucchini croquettes with tzatziki, kebab, orzo with shrimp and squid, grilled octopus, Greek salads and slow-cooked beef.
descriptions.pane-e-vino-west-65: Italian and Mediterranean food in West 65: homemade gnocchi with gorgonzola and tortellini with smoked ricotta, pasta, sea bass, tuna steak and octopus in a corn crust.
descriptions.marukoshi: Japanese home-style cooking beyond sushi: miso soup, donburi, ramen and udon with homemade noodles, gyoza, Japanese curry, okonomiyaki, yakitori, tempura and matcha desserts.
descriptions.sushi-wok: Asian-Japanese menu: rolls and nigiri, baked rolls, udon wok dishes, ramen, miso soup, tom yum, hot dishes and sushi burgers.
descriptions.sushi-tempo: Sushi and Japanese-Asian hot menu: rolls, nigiri and gunkan, gyoza, miso soup and tom yum, seafood wok, rice, bowls and edamame.
descriptions.sushi-tempo-vozdovac: Voždovac branch with the same Sushi Tempo menu: rolls, nigiri and gunkan, gyoza, miso soup and tom yum, seafood wok, rice, bowls and edamame.
descriptions.sushi-xo: Sushi chain with three Belgrade locations: signature and classic rolls, Philadelphia, tempura and baked rolls, maki, nigiri, gunkan, onigiri and soups.
descriptions.sushiboks-ada: Sushi bar in Ada Mall: rolls with salmon, tuna, shrimp and cream cheese, Philadelphia rolls, tobiko and masago, spicy and baked options.
descriptions.true-ramen: Ramen bar on Brankova: shoyu, miso, shio, tantan and kimchi ramen, chashu ramen, karaage, shrimp gyoza, edamame and beef tataki.
descriptions.burrito-madre-terazije: Mexican fast-casual: burritos and tacos with achiote chicken, barbacoa or carnitas, quesadillas, nachos, guacamole, salsas and churros.
descriptions.mala-moskva: Russian cuisine with a meat focus: chicken shawarma, chicken and pork shashlik, beef Stroganoff, borscht, okroshka and solyanka; drinks include mors and medovukha.
descriptions.ruske-palacinke-zemun: Russian-recipe crêpe shop on Masarikov trg: sweet crêpes with condensed milk, tvorog, jam and caramel, plus savory versions with ham and cheese or vegetable fillings.
descriptions.samovarrs-bw: Home-style Russian food on Karađorđeva: borscht with Borodinsky bread, okroshka, pelmeni and vareniki, syrniki, crêpes, chicken cutlets and medovik.
descriptions.stroganov-family: Home-style Russian food and prepared dishes: borscht and okroshka, pork-and-beef pelmeni, homemade cutlets with buckwheat, crêpes, syrniki, medovik and Napoleon cake.
descriptions.ura-russian-dumplings: Russian food by Russian cooks: pelmeni with pork and beef, chicken, turkey and other fillings, vareniki with potatoes, tvorog or berries; fried versions, draniki and kvass are also available.
descriptions.thai-zone-vracar: Family Thai restaurant founded in 2017. Chef La-iad Nikolić prepares pad thai, khao pad, tom yum and tom kha, yum woon sen, spring rolls, wok noodles and Thai curries; the restaurant follows traditional Thai recipes.
descriptions.stories-georgian: Georgian cuisine at Piarona de Mondezira 28: khinkali with meat, cheese or mushrooms, Adjarian khachapuri, ojakhuri, satsivi, adjika and tkemali.
descriptions.cevabdzinica-savcic: Sarajevo-style ćevapi restaurant founded in 2013: ćevapi made to a Sarajevo recipe with 70% beef and 30% veal, pljeskavica, veal sudžukica and kajmak.
descriptions.curry-souls-centar: Sri Lankan street food: kottu roti, chicken and tuna curries, roti, dal and pol sambol. The Belgrade flagship opened in summer 2023; the founders are Clement Senaratne and Kai Bordel.
descriptions.kod-vijetnamca: Vietnamese food: phở bò and other rice-noodle soups, fresh and fried spring rolls, rice and noodle dishes; the menu explicitly presents the food as authentic Vietnamese cuisine.
descriptions.aigo-mashisoyo: Korean food: bibimbap, japchae, tteokbokki, gimbap, jeon, dosirak and jjigae; bulgogi, dak-galbi and gochujang-based dishes are also available.
descriptions.byblos-vracar: Lebanese food: hummus, falafel, tabbouleh and other mezze, shish taouk, manakish and Lebanese pastries. Byblos says it brought Lebanese cuisine to Belgrade more than two decades ago.
descriptions.maikhana-indian: Indian cuisine: samosas with chutney, butter chicken, aloo paratha, dal makhani, chicken or vegetable biryani with basmati rice, matar paneer and lamb curry; vegan dishes are available.
descriptions.milagro-zemun: Spanish-Mediterranean restaurant and tapas bar: jamón ibérico, Manchego cheese, padrón peppers, croquettes, paella Valenciana, black paella and seafood paella; crema catalana for dessert.
descriptions.puter-bistro: French bistro with a Balkan accent. Chef Vladimir Popović builds the menu around French technique: Parisian gnocchi, Dauphiné ravioli, duck, rabbit, fish and crème brûlée.
descriptions.pastel-de-nata-novi-beograd: Portuguese-Brazilian café: pastel de nata, brigadeiro, quindim, passion-fruit mousse, coxinha and empada. The project has two active Belgrade locations; this one is in Blok A at Uroša Martinovića 6.
descriptions.r-tiam-uyghur: Xinjiang Uyghur cuisine: lagman, lamb plov, steamed manti, lamb skewers, fried Xinjiang noodles and dapanji (新疆大盘鸡), spicy Xinjiang-style chicken.
descriptions.georgian-supra: Georgian cuisine: khinkali, Adjarian, Imeretian and Megrelian khachapuri, lobiani, shkmeruli, gebzhalia, pkhali and pelamushi; Georgian wines are available.
descriptions.turkuaz-restaurant: Turkish food: lahmacun, menemen, mezze and hummus, İskender kebab, beyti, bulgur and other kebabs; baklava for dessert. The restaurant at Dositejeva 1a states that its menu is fully halal.
descriptions.jan-restaurant: Armenian food: shashlik and grilled meat, lula kebab, pork ribs, chicken and shawarma.
descriptions.king-tut: Egyptian food: koshari, hawawshi, ta'ameya, mahshi, kofta, ful and om ali dessert.
descriptions.ikea-swedish-bistro: IKEA Swedish restaurant and bistro: meatballs, plant balls, Swedish pastries and cinnamon buns; the bistro also serves hot dogs and ice cream.
descriptions.hard-rock-belgrade: American food: Legendary Burger, BBQ ribs, wings, sandwiches, steaks and brownies.
descriptions.kfc-delta-city: American fried-chicken chain: Hot Wings, Strips, Zinger, Twister and French fries.
descriptions.kfc-ada-drive-thru: American fried-chicken chain: Hot Wings, Strips, Zinger, Twister and French fries.
descriptions.kfc-studentski-trg: American fried-chicken chain: Hot Wings, Strips, Zinger, Twister and French fries.
descriptions.kfc-usce: American fried-chicken chain: Hot Wings, Strips, Zinger, Twister and French fries.
descriptions.kfc-ava-shopping-park: American fried-chicken chain: Hot Wings, Strips, Zinger, Twister and French fries.

descriptions.mcdonalds-blok-41-dt: American fast-food chain: Big Mac, cheeseburgers, McChicken, Chicken McNuggets, McWrap and French fries.

descriptions.mcdonalds-ava-park-dt: American fast-food chain: Big Mac, cheeseburgers, McChicken, Chicken McNuggets, McWrap and French fries.
descriptions.mcdonalds-bezistan: American fast-food chain: Big Mac, cheeseburgers, McChicken, Chicken McNuggets, McWrap and French fries.
descriptions.biryani-central: Indian food: chicken biryani, butter chicken, chicken curry, dal tadka, palak paneer, kheer and mango lassi.
descriptions.indian-punjabi-cuisine: Punjabi food: samosa and pakora, chicken tikka, tandoori chicken, curries, palak paneer, naan and chicken biryani.
descriptions.tao-thai: Thai food: pad thai, massaman curry, pad kra pao, pad see ew, tom-yum fried rice and dishes with coconut milk.
descriptions.tuk-tuk-thai: Thai food: satay, red and massaman curries, Thai noodles and rice, spring rolls and mango sticky rice.
descriptions.anadolija-turkish: Turkish and Anatolian food: menemen, shakshuka, haydari, pide, lahmacun, manti, saç tava and tandır kebab.
descriptions.kultura-turkish: Turkish food: menemen, shakshuka, haydari, ezme, pide, lahmacun, Turkish köfte and baklava.
descriptions.osteria-mozzarella: Regional Italian cuisine: pasta, risotto, pizza, meat and fish dishes, seafood, cheeses and desserts.
descriptions.trattoria-campania: Cuisine of Campania: wood-fired Neapolitan pizza, burrata, pasta, Neapolitan ragù, polpette and torta caprese.
descriptions.trattoria-pepe: Italian trattoria in Dorćol: fresh handmade pasta, pizza, focaccia, risotto, meat dishes and tiramisu.
descriptions.luigi-pizzeria: Italian street food: Neapolitan pizza, panuozzo, pizza a portafoglio, pasta, lasagna and arancini.
descriptions.moon-sushi-nbg: Japanese and Asian food: sushi and rolls, salmon tartare, edamame, gyoza, donburi and hot dishes.
descriptions.ebisu-square-nine: Japanese cuisine: teppanyaki, ramen, soft-shell crab, aburi sushi, sashimi and sake.
descriptions.hanan: Lebanese food: falafel, hummus, tabbouleh, shawarma, shish taouk, kibbeh, mezze and baba ghanoush.
descriptions.yalla-yalla: Lebanese street food: falafel, chicken shawarma, hummus, lentil soup and tahini-based dishes.
descriptions.zapata-pozo: Mexican food: chimichanga, guacamole, enchilada, burrito, quesadilla, tacos and pico de gallo.
descriptions.zapata-zvezdara: Mexican and Tex-Mex dishes: tacos, enchiladas, burritos, quesadillas and salsas.
descriptions.zapata-ciudad: Mexican cuisine: tacos, enchiladas, burritos, quesadillas and cocktails.
descriptions.zapata-cerezo: Mexican and Tex-Mex at Jurija Gagarina 19a: burritos, tacos, quesadillas, nachos, guacamole and enchiladas.
descriptions.la-chona: Mexican taqueria at Kneginje Ljubice 26: house-made nixtamalized corn tortillas, tacos, salsas and quesadillas.
descriptions.la-taqueria-gracanicka: Mexican restaurant at Gračanička 7 serving tacos, nachos, quesadillas, guacamole and tostadas.
descriptions.nachos-dorcol: Tex-Mex restaurant at Strahinjića Bana 66a with nachos, tacos, quesadillas, burritos and fajitas.
descriptions.seasons-by-stories: Georgian restaurant at Kalenić market, unit 205: Adjarian and Megrelian khachapuri, khinkali with beef, cheese or seafood, and kharcho.
descriptions.wok-republic-dorcol: Asian street food at Francuska 5: made-to-order wok bowls with noodles or rice, vegetables, protein and sauces; not limited to Chinese cuisine.
descriptions.wok-republic-novi-beograd: Asian street food at Španskih boraca 75: customized wok noodles or rice, vegetables, proteins and sauces; not exclusively Chinese cuisine.
descriptions.wok-republic-big-fashion: Asian street food at BIG Fashion, Višnjička 84: customized wok noodles or rice with vegetables, proteins and sauces; not exclusively Chinese cuisine.
descriptions.tortilla-casa-centar: Mexican fast-casual: burritos, quesadillas, soft and crunchy tacos, taquitos, Crunchwrap and churros.
descriptions.golden-wok: Chinese food: crispy chicken, meat with peanuts and cashews, sweet-and-sour dishes, udon, spring rolls and mapo tofu.
descriptions.yxlanzh: Northwestern Chinese cuisine: hand-pulled noodles and soups, dumplings, fried rice, cumin beef, tofu and wood-ear mushroom dishes.
descriptions.mo-sarpi-beograd: Chinese street food: roujiamo, a crisp flatbread filled with slow-cooked meat, cold liangpi noodles and baozi; located at Makedonska 5 near Trg Republike.
descriptions.da-noodles: Chinese noodle shop: homemade noodles in broth or dry, Hong Kong-style chow mein and chow fun, dumplings with beef, pork or chicken; located at Makedonska 5.
descriptions.k-kitchen: Korean and East Asian menu centered on bibimbap: beef, chicken, pork, shrimp and vegetable versions, spicy chicken with Korean gochujang paste; fried udon and tempura are also served.
descriptions.xalo-ocakbasi: Turkish ocakbaşı: Adana and Urfa kebab, tavuk şiş, dürüm, lahmacun, Turkish köfte, çoban salad and ayran; located at Makedonska 5, unit 33.
descriptions.intergalactic-diner-centar: American diner: classic, smash and UFO burgers, pork ribs, fries and onion rings, American pancakes with maple syrup and milkshakes.
descriptions.intergalactic-diner-novi-beograd: American diner: classic, smash and UFO burgers, pork ribs, fries and onion rings, American pancakes with maple syrup and milkshakes.
descriptions.asia-food-delta-city: Chinese food: hot-and-sour soup, fried rice and noodles, Sichuan chicken and beef, sweet-and-sour chicken, peanut chicken, mapo tofu and spring rolls.
descriptions.dva-stapica-nbg: Chinese food: hot-and-sour soup, spring rolls, chicken with peanuts in a spicy Sichuan sauce, sweet-and-sour chicken balls, wheat noodles and fried rice.
descriptions.good-dumplings-brankov: Chinese dumpling shop: hot-and-sour soup, pickled cabbage, boiled and fried dumplings with pork, chicken or beef, rice and noodles.
descriptions.berezka-bistro-dorcol: Café and prepared-food counter inside Berezka with its own kitchen: pelmeni and vareniki, syrniki, herring under a fur coat, vinaigrette salad, Olivier salad and ready-made lunches. The bistro also serves international dishes.
descriptions.berezka-bistro-sarajevska: Café and prepared-food counter inside Berezka with its own kitchen: pelmeni and vareniki, syrniki, herring under a fur coat, vinaigrette salad, Olivier salad and ready-made lunches. The bistro also serves international dishes.
descriptions.berezka-bistro-vracar: Café and prepared-food counter inside Berezka with its own kitchen: Siberian pelmeni, syrniki, herring under a fur coat, vinaigrette salad, Olivier salad and ready-made lunches. The bistro also serves international dishes.
descriptions.berezka-bistro-novi-beograd: Café and prepared-food counter inside Berezka with its own kitchen: pelmeni and vareniki, syrniki, herring under a fur coat, vinaigrette salad, Olivier salad and ready-made lunches. The bistro also serves international dishes.
descriptions.djordjija-zemun: Georgian restaurant on the Zemun quay (Kej oslobođenja 73): khinkali, Adjarian, Imeretian and Megrelian khachapuri, lobiani, kubdari, ajapsandali and Georgian wines.
descriptions.eatalian-dorcol: Italian food bar in Dorćol serving piadina, panini, pasta, lasagna, Italian cheeses and cured meats.
descriptions.pizza-bar-novi-beograd: Pizzeria in Novi Beograd offering thin-crust Italian-style and thick Chicago-style pizzas, pasta and risotto.
descriptions.prana-brunch-hilandarska: Brunch restaurant with a mixed menu: fresh handmade pasta, breakfasts, poke bowls and desserts. Not exclusively Italian.
descriptions.dolcino-miljakovac: Café, dessert shop and restaurant in Miljakovac with pizza, pasta, risotto, breakfasts and desserts. A mixed menu featuring Italian dishes.
descriptions.gurme-doner-sremska: Turkish döner kebab and halal street food on Sremska: chicken and beef döner, flatbreads, side dishes and sauces.
descriptions.cypress-tacos-rige-od-fere: Mexican street food in Dorćol: tacos, burritos and quesadillas. The Cypress Tacos location on Rige od Fere.
descriptions.taverna-piatakia-zemun: Greek music taverna in Zemun with meze, Greek specialties and live Greek music, at Novogradska 10.
descriptions.moon-sushi-centar: Sushi and Asian fusion in the city centre at Trg Politika 3: rolls, salmon tartare, edamame, donburi and hot dishes.
descriptions.angry-monk-uzun-mirkova: Japanese-inspired pan-Asian fusion at Uzun Mirkova 11: sushi, rolls, ramen, hot dishes and cocktails; not exclusively Japanese.
descriptions.diwali-mahal-senjak: Indian restaurant at Sanje Živanovića 2b serving curries, tandoor dishes, vegetable masala, rice, Indian breads and snacks.
descriptions.piatakia-novi-beograd: Greek restaurant at Bulevar Arsenija Čarnojevića 54: meze, baked feta, calamari and other Greek and eastern Mediterranean dishes.
descriptions.mezestoran-dvoriste: Greek and Mediterranean cuisine in a courtyard at Svetogorska 46: meze, zucchini croquettes with tzatziki, octopus orzo and regional dishes.
descriptions.sushi-factory-vracar: Sushi restaurant at Kursulina 12: signature rolls, gyoza, poke and Japanese-Asian hot dishes. A separate Sushi Factory location.
descriptions.sushirrito-vracar: Sushirrito is Japanese-Asian street food at Krunska 30, serving oversized sushi burritos, poke bowls, rice dishes and mochi. This is the Vračar branch.
descriptions.fine-sushi-vracar: Japanese sushi restaurant at Hadži Đerina 28, Vračar, offering rolls, nigiri, sashimi and Japanese hot dishes.
descriptions.fine-sushi-novi-beograd: Fine Sushi branch in A Blok, Uroša Martinovića 12, serving sushi, rolls, nigiri and Japanese dishes.
descriptions.sushirrito-belvil: Japanese-Asian street food in Belville, Jurija Gagarina 14v: sushi burritos, rolls, poke and rice bowls, and mochi. A separate branch.
descriptions.indian-arab-marsala-birjuzova: Indian restaurant at Maršala Birjuzova 2–4 serving curries, tandoori chicken, aloo gobi, rice dishes and vegetable starters. Not the Arab restaurant at Brankova 19.
descriptions.zen-by-sushico-galerija: Japanese and pan-Asian cuisine on the second floor of Galerija mall: sushi, nigiri, sashimi, dim sum, tempura and hot dishes. Not exclusively Japanese.
descriptions.mister-wang-slavija: Chinese restaurant near Slavija at Deligradska 3 serving sweet-and-sour and spicy Sichuan dishes, rice, vegetable and meat mains. A separate Mister Wang branch.
descriptions.black-white-dorcol: Chinese restaurant at Cara Dušana 2 in Dorćol: Sichuan chicken, meat and vegetable dishes, rice and soups. Different from the Novi Beograd branch.
descriptions.black-white-novi-beograd: Chinese cuisine at Bulevar Zorana Đinđića 12e in Novi Beograd: spicy chicken, veal and pork dishes, vegetables, rice and soups.
descriptions.spring-belgrade-dositejeva: Chinese restaurant at Dositejeva 22 offering kung pao chicken, boiled Chinese dumplings, yu xiang pork, rice noodles, spicy tofu and vegetables.
descriptions.oh-dumpling-vracar: Chinese dumpling restaurant at Kralja Milutina 4, serving pan-fried and boiled meat and vegetable dumplings, noodles, soups and sides. Pin from the delivery listing.
descriptions.street-pasta-bar-bulevar: Pasta bar at Patrijarha Gavrila 1 offering tomato- and cream-based pasta, gluten-free options and risotto. Older listings give Bulevar kralja Aleksandra 94–96 for the same name.
descriptions.kultura-kralja-petra: Turkish restaurant at Kralja Petra 23 with pide and Turkish pizza, grilled dishes, salads and baklava. A separate location from Kultura on Strahinjića Bana.
descriptions.lorenzo-kakalamba: Restaurant at Cvijićeva 110 (entrance from Vladetina) combining Italian dishes with Pirot regional cuisine: pappardelle with ragù, prawn pasta, lasagna and Pirot-style ćevapi. Not exclusively Italian.
descriptions.sushidream-novi-beograd: Japanese fusion at Bulevar Zorana Đinđića 6A in Novi Beograd: sushi, rolls, nigiri, sashimi, miso soup, poke and noodles. The Novi Beograd Sushidream location.
descriptions.sushi-bar-boketto-zvezdara: Japanese sushi bar at Bulevar kralja Aleksandra 312 in Zvezdara offering uramaki, fusion rolls, hosomaki, nigiri, sashimi, chirashi and sushi sets.
descriptions.pastino-vozdovac: Pasta restaurant at Bulevar oslobođenja 243 serving carbonara, bolognese, truffle pasta, gnocchi and risotto.
descriptions.mig-margherita-gelato-novi-beograd: MIG pizzeria at Trešnjinog cveta 1A in Novi Beograd, serving pizza, Italian cheeses, salads and desserts. A distinct Margherita & Gelato location.
descriptions.taurunum-pogled-pizza-bar: Zemun pizzeria at Sinđelićeva 30 overlooking the Danube, with wood-fired pizza, bruschetta, pasta, risotto and grilled dishes. Primarily Italian-style, with a mixed menu.
descriptions.chuan-chuan-xiang-stari-grad: Chinese Sichuan-style eatery at Braće Jugovića 16 near Republic Square, serving spicy hot pot, beef noodle soup and dumplings.
descriptions.wangjiao-despota-stefana: Chinese restaurant at Bulevar despota Stefana 32 specialising in Cantonese-style siu mei roasted meats, dim sum and Hong Kong dishes.
descriptions.piatakia-galerija: Greek restaurant Piatakia on the ground floor of Galerija mall, Bulevar Vudroa Vilsona 14, with meze, tzatziki, halloumi, seafood and Greek main dishes. A separate branch.
descriptions.jamies-italian-waterfront: Italian restaurant at Hercegovačka 14 in Belgrade Waterfront, serving fresh pasta, pizza, antipasti, salads and tiramisu. The Belgrade branch of Jamie's Italian.
descriptions.pomodoro-vidin-dzordza-vasingtona: Italian pizzeria and restaurant Pomodoro Vidin at Džordža Vašingtona 38a with pizza, pasta, risotto, antipasti and desserts. Not the Pomodoro Nuovo branch in Novi Beograd.
descriptions.majstor-i-margarita-centar: Neapolitan-style pizzeria Majstor i Margarita at Vuka Karadžića 12, serving margherita pizza, mortadella-and-pistachio pizza, salads and desserts. The central branch.
descriptions.majstor-i-margarita-bulevar: Separate Majstor i Margarita Neapolitan-style pizzeria at Bulevar kralja Aleksandra 248a, offering Italian-style pizzas, sandwiches, soups and salads.
descriptions.caviar-sushi-bistro-dalmatinska: Caviar sushi restaurant at Dalmatinska 65a offers nigiri, sashimi, gunkan, uramaki, poke and ramen. Pickup and delivery are available; Japanese cuisine with fusion elements.
descriptions.spice-banovo-brdo: Spice Indian restaurant at Žarkovačka 21a in Banovo Brdo serves tandoori dishes, curries, biryani, samosas, naan and vegetarian options. This is a dine-in restaurant, unlike the chain's delivery-focused outlets.
descriptions.spice-autokomanda: Indian food from Spice at Tabanovačka 2, Autokomanda: curries, tandoor dishes, biryani, dal and naan. The chain's official website identifies this as a delivery outlet, so dine-in seating is not assumed.
descriptions.bizu-sushi-fusion-senjak: Sushi restaurant in Senjak, Andre Nikolića 1–3: classic and signature rolls, sushi and modern Asian-European fusion dishes. The menu is not exclusively Japanese.
descriptions.mi-da-house-tetovska: Family restaurant at Tetovska 59 serving Korean and northern Chinese food: bulgogi, gimbap, dumplings and fried rice. Not Thai; the Korean marker represents one of its two main culinary traditions.
descriptions.bella-napoli-zemun: Italian restaurant and pizzeria in Zemun, Zmaj Jovina 35: tagliatelle with prosciutto served from a Parmesan wheel, gnocchi, pizza, seafood and tiramisu.
descriptions.piano-loco-vozdovac: Pizzeria and beer restaurant in Voždovac, Vojvode Stepe 203: pizza, pasta, risotto, salads and other dishes. A mixed menu with an Italian focus.
descriptions.amici-vracar: Italian trattoria at Nebojšina 8, with entrance from Karađorđev Park: Roman-style pizza from a wood-fired oven, handmade pasta, meat dishes and Italian wines.
descriptions.pad-thai-wok-galerija: Thai and pan-Asian food in the Galerija mall Food Hall (Bulevar Vudroa Vilsona 14): pad thai rice noodles, tom yum, rice bowls, spring rolls and gyoza. The mall directory lists the second floor.
descriptions.pad-thai-wok-rajiceva: Thai and pan-Asian food in the Rajićeva mall Food Hall, Knez Mihaila 54, second floor: pad thai with chicken, beef or vegetables, tom yum, rice bowls and spring rolls. Separate branch.
descriptions.cuoco-zvezdara: Italian trattoria in Zvezdara, Bulevar kralja Aleksandra 250: pizza, pasta, soups, desserts and dishes from different Italian regions.
descriptions.casa-nova-dorcol: Italian-French restaurant in Dorćol, serving homemade pasta, meat dishes and Mediterranean cuisine. Its own website identifies both traditions, with an Italian foundation.
descriptions.natura-bar-falafel-house-vozdovac: Middle Eastern food in Voždovac: falafel, hummus, shawarma and kebab. PlanPlus classifies the venue as Lebanese, while the menu spans more than one national tradition.
descriptions.fat-cat-sushi-savski-venac: Sushi bar at Braće Krsmanović 1: sushi rolls, tempura shrimp and poke bowls. Japanese-inspired contemporary cuisine.
descriptions.zrno-pirinca-banovo-brdo: Chinese fast food at Trebevićka 8a: rice noodles, meat and vegetables in sauces, Sichuan dishes and meat-free options. Some directories list the same address as CHAOS Banovo Brdo.
descriptions.pandica-rakovica: Chinese fast food in Rakovica, Kneza Višeslava 31g: noodles, rice, chicken with peanuts and other dishes; delivery available.
descriptions.comunale-beton-hala: Italian and Mediterranean cuisine at Beton Hala, Karađorđeva 2–4: pizza, Italian starters and dishes from the Josper charcoal grill.
descriptions.diwali-palace-vozdovac: Indian restaurant at Ljubićka 1b: chicken tikka masala, curries, biryani, dal, samosas, tandoori dishes and naan. Separate address from Diwali Mahal in Senjak.
descriptions.thyme-indian-streetfood-zvezdara: Indian street food in Zvezdara, Bulevar kralja Aleksandra 212: butter chicken, samosas, biryani and tandoori dishes. The Indian concept of Thyme, distinct from its other bistros.
descriptions.matignon-former-gallo-nero-dorcol: Italian and French restaurant and lounge in Dorćol, formerly Gallo Nero. Dobračina 6.
descriptions.la-tavernetta-zvezdara: Italian restaurant and pizzeria in Zvezdara serving pizza, pasta, calzone and salads. Dimitrija Tucovića 119.
descriptions.arlecchino-kralja-milutina: Italian pizzeria at Kralja Milutina 57: pizza baked in a Neapolitan oven, including mortadella and pistachio or truffle toppings, focaccia and folded pizza (pizza a portafoglio).
descriptions.rustique-senjak: Italian restaurant in Senjak, Vase Pelagića 48A: pizza, pasta, Italian mains, desserts and breakfast.
descriptions.insolita-dorcol: Italian restaurant in the Dorćol gastro park (Žorža Klemansoa 27v), serving pizza, handmade pasta, burrata and main courses.
descriptions.pasta-2x2-kneza-danila: Pasta bar at Kneza Danila 22, offering Italian pasta dishes with various sauces and delivery.
descriptions.la-trattoria-verde: Restaurant at Jurija Gagarina 15 in New Belgrade. Mixed Italian and Serbian cuisine: pizza, pasta, grilled meat and salads.
descriptions.extra-sushi-vojislava-ilica: Sushi rolls, sashimi, tempura and miso soup, alongside Caucasian dishes and pelmeni. Current delivery address: Vojislava Ilića 102. Dine-in at this address is not confirmed.
descriptions.green-panetteria-filmski-grad: Pizzeria in Filmski Grad, Ratka Mitrovića 181V: Italian pizza, pasta, pinsa, piadina and salads, alongside American and Serbian dishes.
descriptions.kissa10-dorcol: Cocktail bar and contemporary izakaya in Dorćol, Dobračina 29a: Japanese kushiyaki, okonomiyaki, tempura, miso soup and mochi, plus other Asian dishes. Not exclusively Japanese cuisine.
descriptions.eleven-dorcol: Chinese restaurant in Dorćol: dim sum, bao buns, noodles, soups, wood ear mushroom salads and Chinese tea. Gospodar Jovanova 27.
descriptions.mister-wang-novi-beograd: Mister Wang branch in New Belgrade, Omladinskih brigada 18b: Chinese dishes with rice, noodles, meat, vegetables and various sauces; delivery available.
descriptions.soya-sos-autokomanda: Soya Sos Chinese restaurant at Autokomanda, Bulevar oslobođenja 18a: meat and vegetables in sauces, rice, noodles, tofu and seafood; delivery available.
descriptions.soya-sos-vukov-spomenik: Soya Sos branch near Vukov spomenik, Kraljice Marije 39: Chinese meat, vegetable and seafood dishes, rice and tofu; delivery available.
descriptions.soya-sos-fontana: Soya Sos branch in the Fontana area, Pariske komune 15a: Chinese cuisine, meat and vegetables in sauces, rice, spring rolls and vegetarian dishes. Delivery available.
descriptions.pro-eat-sushi-tosin-bunar: Sushi bar at Tošin Bunar 57: nigiri, maki, sashimi, tempura rolls, soups and vegan options; delivery available.
descriptions.wang-fu-blok-70: Chinese restaurant in the Block 70 area, Jurija Gagarina 26v: hot and sour soup, noodles, meat dishes, tofu and spring rolls.
descriptions.gangnam-grmec-zemun: Chinese restaurant in Zemun, Grmeč 1. nova 21a: fried dumplings, rice with beef, noodles, chicken dishes and hot and sour soup. Delivery available.
descriptions.amigos-mexican-grill-galerija: Mexican fast food in Galerija mall, Bulevar Vudroa Vilsona 14: tacos, burritos, nachos and quesadillas. The mall directory lists the second floor, Belgrade Avenue; Wolt lists the third-floor Food Hall and street number 12. The Wolt pin is a mall-area anchor; confirm the floor on site.
descriptions.buena-vida-novi-beograd: Mexican gastrobar in New Belgrade, Bulevar Milutina Milankovića 1i: tacos, quesadillas, burritos, empanadas and cocktails.
descriptions.tutto-bene-savamala: Italian pizzeria and trattoria at Gavrila Principa 60a: pizza, pasta, lasagna and salads.
descriptions.mamma-mia-resavska: Italian restaurant at Resavska 70: pizza, pasta, risotto, meat and fish dishes. The pin marks the shared building at Resavska 68–76 in which the map directory lists the restaurant; the entrance has not been verified.
descriptions.giulia-galerija: Italian restaurant on the waterfront at Galerija, Bulevar Vudroa Vilsona 12 (14 in PlanPlus): homemade pasta, pizza, risotto, burrata and tiramisu. Pin from the Wolt venue listing.
descriptions.boutique-1-republic-square: Restaurant at Republic Square, Trg republike 3. International cuisine with a substantial Italian selection: pizza, pasta and risotto, plus breakfast, burgers and grilled dishes. Not exclusively Italian.
descriptions.pastis-bistro-dorcol: French-style café-bistro in Dorćol, Strahinjića Bana 52b: croissants, sandwiches, breakfast, desserts and wine. Not a full-service classical French cuisine restaurant.
descriptions.fabrika-pizze-novi-beograd: Pizzeria in Block 72, Mileve Marić Ajnštajn 82: pizza, pasta, risotto, calzone and salads. Dine-in and delivery. Distinct from Pizza Fabrika in Vračar.
descriptions.castello-bianco-dusanovac: Delivery kitchen in Dušanovac, Đorđa Kratovca 43 (entrance from Vidska): pizza, pasta, sandwiches and Serbian grilled dishes. Mixed menu with Italian dishes; dine-in seating is unconfirmed.
descriptions.via-del-gusto-knez-mihailova: Restaurant on the pedestrian street Kneza Mihaila 48: Italian and Mediterranean cuisine, pizza, pasta, meat dishes and desserts.
descriptions.galla-novi-beograd: Restaurant in New Belgrade at Bulevar Arsenija Čarnojevića 95. Wood-fired pizza, Italian and other European dishes, and grilled meats; mixed cuisine.
descriptions.portofino-bezanijska-kosa: Pizzeria and restaurant in Bežanijska kosa at Partizanske avijacije 10. Pizza, pasta and meat dishes.
descriptions.cortina-zvezdara: Restaurant in Zvezdara at Čede Mijatovića 8. Pizza, risotto, burrata, breakfasts and burgers; mixed cuisine with Italian dishes. Marker indicates the building, not the restaurant entrance.
descriptions.rodizio-novi-beograd: Restaurant at Bulevar Milutina Milankovića 11b (11c in PlanPlus). Brazilian rodízio tradition: skewered meats carved at the table, plus steaks, fish and other Latin American and international dishes.
descriptions.pivo-i-kobaja-garden: German-Serbian style pub at Ruzveltova 36, opposite Zira shopping centre. German and Serbian sausages, pork knuckle, ribs, wings and beer; garden seating.
descriptions.pivo-i-kobaja-garage: German-Serbian style pub at Mercator shopping centre, Bulevar umetnosti 4, ground floor. Sausages, ribs, wings, burgers and beer.
descriptions.strada-kitchen-bar: Mixed-cuisine restaurant serving Italian dishes including pasta and panini. Gramšijeva 9, Novi Beograd.
descriptions.pizzeria-golub: Italian restaurant and pizzeria serving pizza, pasta and other dishes. Bulevar kralja Aleksandra 204.
descriptions.umami-cocktail-sushi-bar: Cocktail and Japanese sushi bar in Gastro Šor, Žorža Klemansoa 29b: sushi, rolls, gyoza and cocktails.
descriptions.wu-ming-crveni-krst: Chinese restaurant in Crveni Krst, Branka Krsmanovića 16: jiaozi dumplings, spring rolls, soups, rice, noodles, duck and chicken in Sichuan sauce.
descriptions.makao-zuto-more-zemun: Chinese restaurant in Zemun, Prve pruge 8. Chicken, pork, duck and seafood dishes, rice and noodles. Coordinates are published in the venue's address listing.
descriptions.makao-i-tasmajdan: Chinese restaurant in Tašmajdan, Starine Novaka 7a. Sichuan-style chicken and beef, noodles, rice and vegetables. The official homepage confirms reopening.
descriptions.makao-ii-rakovica: Chinese restaurant in Rakovica, Pere Velimirovića 7. Chicken, pork, duck and seafood with vegetables and sauces. The point represents the restaurant building's OpenStreetMap centroid, not the entrance.
descriptions.sushi-factory-zemun: Japanese restaurant in Zemun, Gospodska 11: maki, nigiri, sashimi, sushi rolls, miso soup and gyoza. Separate Sushi Factory branch.
descriptions.hayal-yu-business-center: Turkish restaurant at YU Business Center, Bulevar Mihajla Pupina 10D/4: meze, kebabs, menemen and Turkish breakfasts. Also listed as Tron.
descriptions.burrito-madre-bulevar: Mexican fast food at Bulevar kralja Aleksandra 184: burritos, tacos, quesadillas, nachos and salsas. Separate branch of the chain.
descriptions.burrito-madre-usce: Mexican fast food in UŠĆE Shopping Center, Bulevar Mihajla Pupina 4: burritos, tacos, quesadillas, nachos and salsas. Separate branch of the chain.
descriptions.tortilla-casa-novi-beograd: Mexican fast food at Bulevar Zorana Đinđića 48B: burritos, tacos, quesadillas, nachos and churros. Separate branch of the chain.
descriptions.tortilla-casa-vidikovac: Mexican fast food at Patrijarha Joanikija 34, Vidikovac: burritos, tacos, quesadillas, nachos and churros. Separate branch of the chain.
descriptions.hanan-shawarma-damask: Middle Eastern street food from Hanan at Njegoševa 31v: chicken or veal shawarma, falafel and baklava. Separate outlet of the Lebanese restaurant Hanan.
descriptions.hanan-shawarma-jerusalim: Middle Eastern street food from Hanan at Strahinjića Bana 57: shawarma, falafel and Middle Eastern desserts. Separate outlet of the Lebanese restaurant Hanan.
descriptions.buon-appetito-karaburma: Café and pizzeria in the Karaburma shopping centre, Mirijevski bulevar 18B. Pizza and a mixed menu.
descriptions.klopizza-staklenac: Pizza, grilled dishes and pancakes; mixed cuisine, Makedonska 5. Delivery and takeaway.
descriptions.stivale-vidikovac: Pizzeria in Vidikovac, Vidikovački venac 80V: pizza, pasta, calzone and sandwiches.
descriptions.pastoteka-studentski-trg: Restaurant at Studentski trg 21 serving homemade pasta, risotto, pizza and bruschetta, alongside breakfast and international dishes.
descriptions.baguette-cafe-bircaninova: French bistro at Birčaninova 7: onion soup, tartare, croissants and French wines, alongside international dishes.
descriptions.milla-ex-per-tutti: Pizzeria at Južni bulevar 38, formerly Per Tutti: pizza, pasta, panini and other dishes. Some directories retain the former name.
descriptions.snezana-knez-mihailova: Café, pastry shop and pizzeria at Kneza Mihaila 50: pizza, pasta, bruschetta, breakfast and desserts. Mixed cuisine with Italian dishes.
descriptions.la-luna-batajnica: Italian and mixed-cuisine restaurant in Batajnica, Majora Zorana Radosavljevića 246: Margherita, Capricciosa, house pizzas and meat dishes.
descriptions.status-pizzeria-cukarica: Restaurant and pizzeria at Stevana Đurđevića Trošarinca 1 (1A in PlanPlus). Italian-style pizza, pasta, meat dishes and burgers; mixed menu.
descriptions.lonce-dorcol: Mixed Serbian and international restaurant at Braće Jugovića 4–6, with homemade tagliatelle and wholewheat pasta. Also serves chrono-diet dishes; Italian food is one part of the menu.
descriptions.kitchen-bar-27: Restaurant at 27. marta 5, also known as Kitchen Bar 27: pizza, pasta, meat dishes, burgers and breakfasts. Mixed cuisine with Italian dishes.
descriptions.flamingo-obilicev-venac: Chinese restaurant in central Belgrade, Obilićev venac 18–20: soups, noodles and Chinese dishes. The current venue listing also uses the name Quan Ju De.
descriptions.bastino-banovo-brdo: Restaurant in Banovo Brdo, Požeška 83a: pizza, salmon penne, focaccia, meat dishes and breakfast. Mixed cuisine with Italian dishes.
descriptions.ultimatum-vracar: Café-restaurant in Vračar, Patrijarha Varnave 22–24: pizza, pasta, prosciutto and parmesan sandwiches, breakfast and other international dishes.
descriptions.panda-011-borca: Chinese restaurant in Borča, Valjevskog odreda 26: chicken and rice dishes, takeaway and delivery.
descriptions.xiao-la-jiao-novi-beograd: Sichuan restaurant in New Belgrade, Trešnjinog cveta 10e (also listed as Bulevar Mihajla Pupina 10E): spicy chicken, beef and pork dishes and Chinese hot pot.
descriptions.good-appetite-stari-grad: Chinese fast-food restaurant near Republic Square, Vase Čarapića 7: tofu, chicken, vegetable and noodle dishes, with vegetarian options and takeaway.
descriptions.shangri-la-chinese-tea-restaurant: Chinese restaurant in New Belgrade, Trešnjinog cveta 9: pork with bamboo shoots, chicken with peanuts, duck with vegetables, rice dishes and Chinese tea.
descriptions.kung-fu-skadarlija: Chinese restaurant near Skadarlija, Simina 33: fried dumplings, spring rolls, hot-and-sour soup, crispy duck and handmade noodles.
descriptions.lucky-lee-bezanijska-kosa: Chinese food in Bežanijska Kosa, Partizanske avijacije 73b: sweet-and-sour pork, noodles, rice, chicken and vegetable dishes. Delivery and takeaway.
descriptions.sushiboks-savska: Sushi bar at Savska 33 serving rolls, miso soup and other Japanese and pan-Asian dishes. A separate Sushi Boks branch.
descriptions.la-cucina-galerija: Italian restaurant in the Galerija complex serving Roman pizza, fresh pasta, lasagna and caprese. Official address: Bulevar Vudroa Vilsona 12.
descriptions.da-pippo-galerija: Italian restaurant in Galerija shopping centre, Sava Avenue, first floor (prvi sprat): pizza, pasta carbonara and seafood.
descriptions.broker-novi-beograd: Restaurant in New Belgrade, Antifašističke borbe 23G, unit 5: focaccia, pasta, risotto, pizza and aubergine parmigiana, alongside meat and fish dishes. Mixed menu including Italian cuisine.
descriptions.afifa-halal-food-dorcol: Halal eatery in Dorćol, Gospodar Jevremova 15: chicken shawarma, falafel, hummus, shish tawook and grilled dishes. Mixed Middle Eastern cuisine with Turkish and Arab dishes.
descriptions.meze-turkish-carice-milice: Turkish halal restaurant in the city centre, Carice Milice 5: lentil soup, Iskender kebab, doner, meat and vegetable dishes, baklava and Turkish tea.
descriptions.all-italian-kondina: Italian café and pizzeria at Kondina 16: pizza, pasta, risotto, sandwiches and desserts. Delivery and takeaway available.
descriptions.obrock-beo-shopping-center: Fast-food restaurant at BEO Shopping Center, Vojislava Ilića 141, second floor: Serbian-style gyros, cooked dishes, soups, grilled food and salads. Mixed Serbian and Greek cuisine. The pin indicates the shopping-centre location from the restaurant directory.
descriptions.obrock-big-fashion: O'Brock branch at BIG FASHION, Višnjička 84, second floor, unit 203A. The chain serves mixed Serbian and Greek cuisine: gyros, cooked dishes, grilled food and salads. The pin indicates the shopping-centre location from the restaurant directory.
descriptions.obrock-delta-city: Chain branch at Delta City shopping centre, Jurija Gagarina 16, second floor: Serbian-style gyros, cooked dishes, grilled food and salads. Mixed Serbian and Greek cuisine. Coordinates represent the venue's OpenStreetMap point; the floor is confirmed by the mall directory.
descriptions.la-gitana-cetinjska: Eatery at the Dvorištance bar, Cetinjska 15: nachos with guacamole, pico de gallo and jalapeños, and burgers. Mixed menu with Mexican dishes rather than a traditional Mexican restaurant.
descriptions.istok-outpost-palilula: Pan-Asian eatery at Palilula Market, Ilije Garašanina 5A, unit 35: Thai tom yum, filled steamed buns, rice dishes and noodles. Mixed Thai, Vietnamese and Korean cuisine.
descriptions.mala-riksa-sarajevska-40: Eatery at Sarajevska 40: Chinese dishes with vegetables, tofu and rice dumplings, alongside Serbian cooked dishes. Mixed Chinese and Serbian cuisine; a separate location near Maxi.
descriptions.mala-riksa-maxi-sarajevska: Mala Rikša outlet in the Maxi shopping complex, Sarajevska 38/38A: Chinese and Serbian cooked dishes, vegetables and tofu. Separate outlet; coordinates from the address navigation link, not a surveyed entrance.
descriptions.sushirrito-waterfront: Japanese-Asian Sushirrito restaurant in Belgrade Waterfront, Hercegovačka 15a: large sushi burritos, sushi, poke, gyoza, tempura and mochi. Separate branch with delivery.
descriptions.sushi-queen-blok-62: Sushi bar in New Belgrade, Jurija Gagarina 231, unit 173. Formerly Sushi King, renamed Sushi Queen: nigiri, maki, sashimi, tempura rolls, miso soup and chirashi. Pasta is also on the menu.
descriptions.ararat-banovo-brdo: Lebanese and Armenian eatery in Banovo Brdo, Petra Martinovića 35: falafel, hummus, chicken and beef shawarma, shish tawook and kebab. Delivery and takeaway available. Distinct from the old outlet at Dimitrija Tucovića 55A.
descriptions.piatto-banjica: Restaurant in Banjica, Crnotravska 4, also known as Piatto Saruna. Italian and international cuisine: wood-fired pizza, pasta, burgers and breakfasts.
descriptions.mister-wang-miljakovac: Chinese chain branch in Miljakovac, Borska 45i: kung pao chicken, dishes with vegetables, bamboo, mushrooms and sauces, noodles and rice. Delivery and takeaway available; the menu also includes non-Chinese dishes.
descriptions.cafe-lavash-beton-hala: Restaurant in Beton Hala, Karađorđeva 2–4, with a Balkan and Middle Eastern menu: Adana kebab, hummus, falafel, lavash wraps and baklava. Also serves Indian biryani, Greek souvlaki and Lebanese dishes. Listed under Turkish and Indian cuisine; represented by a single map point.
descriptions.cantina-de-frida-beton-hala: Bar-restaurant in Beton Hala, Karađorđeva 2–4, serving a mix of Spanish, Mexican, Argentine and Mediterranean cuisine: tapas, tacos, enchiladas, guacamole, octopus, grilled meats and churros.
descriptions.asia-kuca-kineske-hrane-zemun: Chinese restaurant in Zemun, Bulevar Mihajla Pupina 20h: chicken with peanuts, sweet-and-sour pork, veal with bamboo shoots, duck with Chinese mushrooms, fish, seafood and tofu. Separate venue, not Asia Food at Delta City.
descriptions.panda-chinese-food-rajiceva: Pan-Asian eatery at Rajićeva shopping centre, Kneza Mihaila 54: kung pao beef, oyster-sauce dishes, rice and noodles, and sushi. Chinese cuisine with Japanese and Thai elements.
descriptions.bambus-restoran-prvomajska: Chinese eatery at Prvomajska 2, named Zhejiang Xiaochi (Zhejiang snacks): dough-based dishes filled with pork, onion and egg, soups and rice dishes. Delivery via Wolt.
descriptions.bella-italia-kod-garica-novi-beograd: Italian restaurant in New Belgrade, Bulevar Arsenija Čarnojevića 95: bruschetta, pasta, spaghetti prepared in a Parmesan wheel, meat and fish dishes, and tiramisu. Separate venue from Bella Napoli in Zemun.
descriptions.constantin-belville: Restaurant in Belville, Bulevar Crvene Armije 9, unit 6P. Italian and international cuisine: pizza, pasta, gnocchi, risotto, steaks and breakfast dishes.
descriptions.s5-by-angie-zemun: Chef-led restaurant in a residential building in Zemun, Avijatičarski trg 5, formerly Salon 5a. Chef Anđela Risimić combines Italian and Serbian cooking; the Michelin Guide highlights rabbit ravioli, mushroom sauce, tiramisu and freshwater fish dishes. The original list classified it as French; its current cuisine is Italian and Balkan.
descriptions.sibirska-noc-vozdovac: Restaurant in Voždovac, Braće Jerković 227A, serving Serbian, Russian and international cuisine. Its dedicated Russian menu includes solyanka, borscht, pelmeni with mushroom sauce, beef Stroganoff and shashlik, alongside Serbian grilled dishes.
descriptions.dorcoleta-dobracina: Pan-Asian restaurant and bar in Dorćol, Dobračina 76, with evening club events. The published August 2024 menu includes nigiri, signature rolls, tempura and edamame. Listed under Japanese and Chinese cuisine; one point with a Japanese marker based on the published menu.
descriptions.little-italy-ada-ciganlija: Italian pizzeria on Ada Ciganlija, between the artificial climbing wall and the bungee jumping area: wood-fired pizza with a choice of toppings and a seasonal pasta of the day. Check opening hours for the season before visiting.
descriptions.new-york-new-york-krunska: Italian and international restaurant in Vračar, Krunska 86: pizza, gnocchi, tagliatelle and carbonara. Wolt delivery is unavailable; check opening hours before visiting.
descriptions.mister-li-bulevar: Chinese restaurant at Bulevar kralja Aleksandra 54: spring rolls, rice, hot-and-sour soup and fried desserts. The marker indicates the building at the address, not the exact entrance.
descriptions.gelato-bar-jurija-gagarina: Italian and international pizzeria and café in New Belgrade, Jurija Gagarina 28: pizza and other menu items. Contact the venue to confirm current hours and reservations.
descriptions.shangri-la-sushi-galerija: Japanese and Chinese restaurant in Galerija, Bulevar Vudroa Vilsona 14 (Wolt lists number 12), Sava Avenue, ground floor, nearest entrance 5. Sushi, maki, nigiri, sashimi, shrimp tempura, Chinese meat dishes, noodles and rice. Separate venue from Shangri La in New Belgrade. The marker represents the centre of the venue outline in OSM.
descriptions.cross-lavina-belville: Restaurant in Belville, Bulevar Crvene Armije 9v. Mixed Italian and Serbian cuisine: Neapolitan pizza, homemade pasta, risotto, burrata and tiramisu, alongside ćevapi and other local dishes.
descriptions.istanbul-house-palilula: Turkish eatery at Palilula market, Ilije Garašanina 5A, unit 31 according to PlanPlus. Restaurant directories describe Turkish cuisine, including döner kebab. A current full menu was not available; confirm opening hours before visiting.
descriptions.ima-sushi-dorcol: Japanese cuisine: sushi and rolls. Strahinjića Bana 52, Dorćol. Delivery and pickup via Alideda; dine-in service has not been confirmed. Approximate building-level marker, not a verified entrance.
descriptions.chaos-novi-beograd: Chinese cuisine including meat and vegetables in sauces, rice and seafood. Bulevar Mihajla Pupina 10D, unit 32, New Belgrade. Delivery and takeaway.
descriptions.k24-severni-bulevar: Chinese cuisine: dishes in Sichuan sauce, tofu, noodles and rice. Severni bulevar 17v. Delivery and takeaway; dine-in not confirmed. Approximate marker at the address shared with Big Wok, K24 entrance not verified.
descriptions.egoiste-deli-bistro: Bistro and wine bar on the corner of Lamartinova 49a and Petra Kočića 12, Vračar. French and Italian cuisine according to restaurant directories, breakfast, wine and coffee. A current full menu was not verified.
descriptions.table-restaurant-vozdovac: Restaurant in the Park Vila Residence complex, Save Maškovića 2, Voždovac. Neapolitan pizza and mixed Italian-Venezuelan cuisine. Two Wolt listings at the same address, TABLE restaurant and pizzeria. Approximate marker; entrance not verified.
descriptions.sapori-di-casa-repiste: Pizzeria and self-service restaurant, Milana Jovanovića 14, Repište, Čukarica. Pizza, takeaway and delivery. Approximate marker for the address of the complex; the specific entrance is not verified.
descriptions.berliner-street-dorcol: Gastrobar in Dorćol, Cara Uroša 18, Berliner's new location since 2026. House-made sausages, hot dogs with various toppings, ribs and fries; contemporary international cuisine in a German beer-bar style. Building-level marker, not a verified entrance.
descriptions.w-contemporary-japanese-galerija: Japanese and contemporary Asian cuisine in Galerija, Bulevar Vudroa Vilsona 12 according to the restaurant (mall address 14), Sava promenade, nearest entrance 5. Nigiri, sashimi, rolls, gyoza, tempura, udon and miso soup. Operation of the former W restaurant in Senjak has not been confirmed.
descriptions.fenjer-senjak: Cafe and pizzeria in Senjak, Vase Pelagića 5 (some older directories list number 3). Coffee, pizza and Italian and Serbian dishes according to restaurant directories. A current full menu has not been directly confirmed.
descriptions.chaos-ustanicka: Chinese cuisine at Ustanička 244D, unit 20, Konjarnik. Dishes in Sichuan sauce, noodles, rice and seafood. Delivery and takeaway. Separate branch from CHAOS in New Belgrade. Approximate building-level marker; entrance not verified.
descriptions.yipin-hot-pot-grmec: Chinese hot pot restaurant in Belgrade Chinatown (Belmax Center), Grmeč Nova 13A, Zemun. Guests cook their selected ingredients at the table in hot broth. Current address is listed on the restaurant website; the old riverside address is not used. Approximate marker for the address within the complex; specific entrance unverified.
